description: NaLiTm₂F₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.54 Å. Li is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and four longer (2.25 Å) Li-F bond lengths. Tm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Tm-F bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.43 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Li and two equivalent Tm atoms to form distorted FLi₂Tm₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Tm₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent FNaLiTm₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent FNaLiTm₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Li, and two equivalent Tm atoms to form distorted FNaLiTm₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Tm₂ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent FNaLiTm₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FLi₂Tm₂ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent FNaLiTm₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Tm atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two equivalent Tm atoms.
